youtube_title: Why Is DMart So Cheap? Bad Quality or Smart Business? They're Tricking You #9 #Shorts
youtube_description:
THEY'RE TRICKING YOU #9. Everything at DMart feels cheaper, so the stuff must be low quality, right? A: low quality. B: different business model. Comment!
Answer: B. The 'cheap = bad' idea is the trick your brain plays. DMart owns most of its stores instead of renting them, so it saves on monthly rent. It pays suppliers fast (about 11 days, vs 30 to 60 days in the industry) and gets better prices in return. It keeps a limited range of fast-selling everyday items and follows an everyday-low-price model instead of flashy sales.
Sources: Zerodha Daily Brief 'Here's how DMart works' (Jan 2025); Kotak Neo (May 2026). Education only, not financial advice.
